I have requested the refund, and I want to be precise about what that means: nothing has moved yet.

Payment 301 of ₹50,000 settled on 18 August against ORD-2402, the annual Enterprise plan. Refunding it is a high impact action, so my request has been recorded as approval #1 and is waiting for a person to release it. I am not able to release it myself, and I have not tried.

Once a colleague approves it, the ₹50,000 goes back to the card it came from. Until then the payment stands.
